title: Install the Entra Policy Suite hybrid worker on a domain-joined server
purpose: Installs the worker that writes the tags of AD-synced users in on-premises AD and reads AD group membership for the rules. It talks to Entra Policy Suite only through its SQL database with the machine's managed identity, and writes AD as the gMSA you name. Nothing inbound, no password, no gallery module. From 2.0.102 the worker updates itself once a day to the version the install runs, only from Invardia's signed release, and switches back to the previous version when the new one fails its self-test.
whenToRun: Once on the worker (an Azure VM or an Azure Arc-enabled server), after Initialize-EpsHybridWorkerAd.ps1 and Grant-EpsHybridWorkerAccess.ps1. Run it once again on a worker installed before 2.0.102, to add its daily update. Again with -Remove to take it away.

runAs.name: local Administrator on the worker
runAs.why: copies the code, sets ACLs, user rights and a scheduled task

changes.object: C:\EntraPolicySuite\versions\<version> (the worker code; the current and the previous version), the junction C:\EntraPolicySuite\app pointing at the current one, C:\EntraPolicySuite\worker.json (the database, the worker name, the gMSA - no secret), C:\EntraPolicySuite\logs
changes.why: the worker runs from there; the daily update switches the junction
changes.undo: -Remove (deletes app and versions; the logs stay)

changes.permission: SYSTEM + Administrators full control; the gMSA read + execute, modify on logs only
changes.why: only administrators may change the code the gMSA runs

changes.permission: Log on as a batch job
changes.why: the scheduled task runs as the gMSA
changes.undo: remove it from the local security policy

changes.permission: member of the local group 'Hybrid agent extension applications' (Azure Arc only)
changes.why: it reads the Arc agent's identity key to get the machine's token

changes.object: scheduled task 'EntraPolicySuite Hybrid Worker' (every 5 minutes, as the gMSA)
scheduled task 'EntraPolicySuite Hybrid Worker Update' (every hour, as SYSTEM)
changes.why: the worker follows the version the install runs: Invardia's signed release is checked (signature, sequence, SHA-256, size, version) before anything is switched; a failed self-test switches back

parameters.name: GmsaName
parameters.help: DOMAIN\name$ of the gMSA the worker writes AD as

parameters.name: SqlServer
parameters.help: <name>.database.windows.net of the Entra Policy Suite database

parameters.name: WorkerName
parameters.help: the worker's name in the heartbeat

parameters.name: ManagedIdentityClientId
parameters.help: a user-assigned identity's client id (Azure VM)

parameters.name: Environment
parameters.help: the AD environment this worker serves (e.g. DMZ_Prod) when you have several AD forests or domains; empty = the only one

readsOnly: the release folder it installs from
network: https://invardia.com and the release download it names (the update check every hour, HTTPS outbound)
whatIf: Every step it would take; nothing is copied, granted or registered.
undo: -Remove: both tasks, the group membership and the code; then Initialize-EpsHybridWorkerAd.ps1 -Remove and Grant-EpsHybridWorkerAccess.ps1 -Remove.
